fixture.trash_home_volume: PRO-BLADE; case-sensitive APFS; owners enabled; read-write

coverage: The opt-in foreign-mount case created a directory entry on S8T, used the mount-specific macOS .Trashes/<uid> payload and metadata, checked the identity-bound native move, verified the source disappeared and the trash payload plus .trashinfo were present, then removed only the verified fixture payload. The directory-tree Trash case also restored descendant bytes from the platform Trash payload.
safety_boundary: This qualifies native single-entry disposition of a directory tree on a foreign mount. Recursive Files Trash remains disabled until the reviewed frozen-inventory worker and broader foreign-mount, quota, permission, collision and unsupported-share matrix are complete. No permanent-delete fallback was used.
